attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The pirates made off with some provisions.","severity":"minor","reason":"Adds what was taken; the briefing says only that the barge was robbed."},{"span":"They always report good harvests when things are otherwise predictable.","severity":"minor","reason":"Asserts a habitual pattern of reporting not in the briefing, stated as fact."},{"span":"Three settlements are holding steady.","severity":"minor","reason":"'Holding steady' embellishes the bare settlement count."}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The bulletin leads correctly with the barge robbery, but its wit misfires: the 'fuel more than the food' quip makes no sense for a grain barge, and 'predictable' is repeated limply. Rehashing the old harvest story pads the bulletin and adds a small unsupported claim."}
